article.title: Atlanta plays New York on 5-game win streak
article.linkText: Atlanta plays New York on 5-game win streak
article.story: Atlanta Hawks (12-6, second in the Eastern Conference) vs. New York Knicks (12-7, fifth in the Eastern Conference) New York; Sunday, 6 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: Atlanta looks to keep its five-game win streak alive when the Hawks take on New York. The Knicks are 10-7 against Eastern Conference opponents. New York is ninth in the NBA with 12.6 offensive rebounds per game led by Karl-Anthony Towns averaging 3.1 offensive boards. The Hawks are 11-2 in Eastern Conference play. Atlanta is the leader in the Eastern Conference scoring 18.4 fast break points per game led by Jalen Johnson averaging 5.4. The Knicks average 109.4 points per game, 2.7 fewer points than the 112.1 the Hawks give up. The Hawks average 14.6 made 3-pointers per game this season, 2.0 more made shots on average than the 12.6 per game the Knicks give up. TOP PERFORMERS: Jalen Brunson is shooting 42.7% and averaging 26.2 points for the Knicks. Towns is averaging 19.2 points over the last 10 games. Johnson is averaging 19.5 points, 9.3 rebounds and 6.7 assists for the Hawks. Nickeil Alexander-Walker is averaging 21.3 points over the last 10 games. LAST 10 GAMES: Knicks: 7-3, averaging 108.9 points, 44.7 rebounds, 28.1 assists, 6.9 steals and 4.4 blocks per game while shooting 46.2% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 102.7 points per game. Hawks: 8-2, averaging 114.9 points, 46.9 rebounds, 29.1 assists, 11.2 steals and 3.8 blocks per game while shooting 44.5% from the field. Their opponents have averaged 110.5 points. INJURIES: Knicks: Jordan Clarkson: out (foot), Andre Drummond: out (head), Miles McBride: out (adductor), OG Anunoby: out (calf). Hawks: CJ McCollum: out (calf), Henri Veesaar: out for season (acl), Jock Landale: out (hip), Mouhamed Gueye: out (foot), Asa Newell: out (toe). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
